newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst announces board members for HMR drugs unit.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst announces board members for HMR drugs unit.

text.p: Germany's Hoechst AG on Wednesday announced the names of the management and supervisory boards for its drugs unit Hoechst Marion Roussel AG.
As part of plans to transform Hoechst AG into a strategic management company, the group's business units are being turned into separate legal entities.

Hoechst has named Richard Markham as chief executive officer and head of the four member management at Hoechst Marion Roussel AG. Daniel Camus will become chief financial officer while Frank Douglas will serve as chief research officer. Uwe Bicker will be in charge of health care synergies.

Horst Waechse, the board member at Hoechst AG in charge of pharmaceuticals, will head the 3 person supervisory board. Hoechst's chief financial officer Klaus-Juergen Schmieder and Hoechst board member Claudio Sonder will also serve on the supervisory board.
